## About
Ly Auto Repair & Mobile Service is a mobile mechanic based on E Huntington Dr in Tempe. Instead of you towing your car to a shop, we come out to you for diagnostics, light engine repair, preventative maintenance, AC recharges and roadside help.
Reviewers keep coming back to the same things: honest answers, patient explanations and careful work. If your car needs something, send us the year, make, model and engine size or the VIN and we'll get you an estimate.

## Services
- Check Engine Light Diagnostics: Check engine light on? We'll come out and find out why.
- Light Engine Repair/ Preventative Maintenance: Lighter engine work and routine maintenance, done where your car is parked.
- AC Recharge Service: Get your AC blowing cold again. (Starting at $150)
- Roadside Assistance ( Fuel Refill/ Lockout Assist): Out of gas or locked out. We come to you within 50 miles of Tempe. ($100 Service Call)

## FAQ
Q: How far will you travel?
A: Roadside assistance is a service call within 50 miles of Tempe. For anything else, reach out and we'll talk through the details.

Q: What do you need from me for an estimate?
A: Send the year, make, model and engine size of your car, or just the VIN.

Q: When can I reach you?
A: Our listed hours are open 24 hours, Monday through Sunday. Call, email or use the contact form.
